Options I see (please advise):

2) Hold a full demo but require that Mediflow complete portal attestation and the NDA redline before dates we propose. That will push into the week of Aug 7+.
3) Provide a one-page "pre-demo security brief" and an engineer-only technical sync while procurement completes the portal — less friction but lower fidelity.

Sean — any objection from pre-demo materials (option 3) re: sharing limited architecture slides?
